Find Neersi's missing wine in [[Nightfallen Jahai]], defeat the [[Torment creature|demons]] guarding the wine crate, then return the wine to Neersi.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defeat the Abominations camped on Neersi's wine.
* Find [[Neersi's Wine]].
* See Neersi for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Inscribed Secret]]

==Walkthrough==
Although this quest is given in the Gate of Torment, you can reach the objective more easily from either the [[Gate of Pain (outpost)|Gate of Pain]] or the [[Gate of the Nightfallen Lands]].

The missing wine crate is located in the north-east area of Nightfallen Jahai, not far from the Gate of Pain mission outpost. There is usually a group of torment creatures near the crate along with several patrolling [[Arm of Insanity|Arms of Insanity]]. The ''Arms'' can be [[pull]]ed separately, after which, the main torment group should be little trouble. Once the area is clear of creatures, click on the wine crate to complete the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Neersi
:''"Greetings, <Character name>. Can you help me? My father was a devout worshiper of [[Lyssa]]. Now he can't cope with the injustice of his imprisonment here. The gods had no choice but to contain those tainted by [[Abaddon]]. But being condemned to this horrid place after a life of service to Lyssa was too much for him."''

:''"Now he's deluded himself into thinking this is [[the Mists]] and that as a follower of Lyssa he should have servants. He shouts to these imagined servants... ordering food and drink, and threatening to complain to Lyssa when nothing appears."''

:''"I bartered for some wine to placate my father, but the merchant got frightened by some [[demon]]s and dropped the crate. Would you defeat the '''demons''' and retrieve my '''missing wine'''?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Of course. It's the least I can do for a devout follower of Lyssa.
|decline = There are servants in the Mists? I wonder who they worshipped to get such a lousy afterlife...
|ask = I fear my father will shake his fist at the feet of Abaddon complaining about the poor service if this goes on much longer. Have you located my '''missing wine'''? }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Neersi
:''"Thank you, <Character name>. My father is content again. I hope to help him adjust once his madness passes. May the Five Gods bless you on your quest to defeat Abaddon. Then perhaps we can all rest in peace."''

==Notes==
* Neersi's Wine is not an [[Alcohol|alcoholic drink]] and cannot be used to improve the [[Drunkard]] title.

{{anomaly|Despite the quest objective stating you have to kill the demons, you only have to click the wine crate to complete the quest.}}
